column1: # Source: Lopez, I.F., Lambert, M.G., Mackay, A.D. & Valentine, I. (2003).
# 'The influence of topography and pasture management on soil characteristics
# and herbage accumulation in hill pasture in the North Island of New Zealand.'
# Ballantrae Research Station, Whanganui-Manawatu - real sheep-grazed hill
# country data. NOT Taranaki itself (Manawatu, adjacent), single year
# (Jul 1997 - Jul 1998), annual totals only across 11 slope/fertility/
# Use as a secondary sanity check on DTT Stratford's dairy-farm figures
# against genuine hill-country sheep numbers, not as a primary source.
